summary: Retested the 5 iteration-333 gaps. Backend: 10/10 new pytest tests pass. (1) POST /api/cash-register/close, the real UI close flow, now writes a db.cash_diff_alerts record. A burger shift with diff 50000 recorded project_id=burger and threshold 10000. A diff of 1000 recorded nothing. When the shift has no project_id, the project is derived from its branch, and a custom threshold of 500 is honoured. (2) GET /api/raw-materials is project scoped. pmburger with inventory ON sees only burger items plus legacy items on burger branches, and cannot override this with ?project_id=shawarma. The owner with ?project_id=shawarma sees only shawarma items plus legacy items on shawarma branches. The owner with no param sees everything. (3) The weekly summary adds closed shifts (total_sales/total_orders) and db.expenses, excluding refunds, using business_date with a date fallback. Open shifts are ignored and legacy shifts on project branches are included. _owner_phones now includes the admin whose project_id is set. GET /projects/owner-weekly-summary returns 403 for pmburger and 200 for the owner. Frontend: the Expenses select (data-testid expenses-branch-select) has the 'كل الفروع' option. With it selected, both burger and shawarma expenses show with project badges, and submitting shows the toast 'اختر الفرع أولاً من القائمة لتسجيل المصروف'. Selecting a burger branch filters the list, and adding an expense succeeds and the new expense is listed. pmburger dashboard: with purchases OFF the purchasing, external-purchases-report and price-increase-report tiles are hidden; with purchases ON all 3 show. One minor frontend race and one minor backend gap were found (see below).

minor.issue: Does not set project_id (resolve_project_id_for_create is not used). Now that GET is strictly scoped, a raw material created by pmburger without a branch_id is saved with project_id=None and branch_id=None. The creator cannot see it afterwards. Verified: POST returned 200, then GET returned []. The frontend currently only GETs this endpoint, so the impact is low.

The endpoint reads only the project_id query param. Check that the axios project interceptor sends ?project_id when the owner picks a project; if it only sends the X-Project-Id header, the owner still sees all projects' materials.

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition. On a direct URL load or hard refresh of /expenses, fetchData runs before ProjectContext has resolved enterpriseEnabled, so selectedBranch defaults to branches[0] ('الفرع الرئيسي') instead of 'all'. SPA navigation correctly defaults to 'all'. Fix: once enterpriseEnabled becomes true and selectedBranch is not 'all' and was not chosen by the user, set it to 'all' (or wait for project context to load).

action_items: Expenses.js: default to 'all' after enterpriseEnabled resolves (direct load or refresh race)
POST /api/raw-materials: set project_id via resolve_project_id_for_create so new items stay visible under the strict scope

Update obsolete iter333 tests: test_send_now_no_phone_400 (now 200, because the admin phone counts) and test_message_lists_all_projects_sorted (it seeds cash_register_closings but the summary now reads shifts)
critical_code_review_comments: send_cash_diff_alert records cash_diff_alerts even when no project_admin has a phone (sent=0). That is fine for audit, but the record does not say why nothing was sent.

Two iter333 regression tests now fail as a result of the intended behaviour changes (not bugs): the weekly summary moved from closings to shifts+expenses, and _owner_phones now includes admins with a project_id.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows work; minor race on direct load)
